clockRules: Browser elapsedMs is the SLO clock; SDK atMs is browser monotonic RPC clock. Service native execution timestamps and Action at times are a separate server chronology. Console loggedAt is only coarse join evidence, not an exact cross-clock conversion.
Native mutation Date.now is fixed. Use reported executionTime/userExecutionTime or explicit performance duration, not equal phase timestamps.

The service milestone intervals are disjoint as reported, not a decomposition added to browser elapsed time. Completion timestamp minus executionTimestamp can exceed executionTime; retain both measures.

Child RPCs and concurrent signal/session/stream/output work overlap. Do not sum all native durations, the full Action duration, or all pre-text observation rounds. Gateway stream timing includes only the observed governed native stream boundary, no invented upstream/internal split.
